subject: Commit clearout playbook & Q4 renewal hygiene
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Commit clearout playbook & Q4 renewal hygiene

Team —

Quick note to kick off a short, timeboxed commit clearout for Q4. Finance needs a validated, cleaned commit list by EOD Friday (11/06) for the week-close forecast. High level ask:

- Update stage to the canonical set (Proposal / Contract / Procurement / Legal / Signed) in the CRM for any account touching a Q4 renewal.
- Flag accounts with >40% churn risk in the "risk_note" field and add a one-line reason.
- For any deal with procurement/PO dependencies, attach expected PO date or a vendor contact.

Attached is a snapshot of current commits (commit_snapshot_q4.csv) and the BrightByte MOU we referenced last month. Use the playbook below when you triage:

Playbook (short):
1) If Contract signed -> move to Signed and mark as Closed-Won in forecast.
2) If Procurement pending > 2 weeks -> keep in Procurement and set forecast to 20% until PO ETA received.
3) If decision deferred or feature gap -> set churn risk and escalate to CS + AE.

Please reply inline with any account-level exceptions or blockers. I will consolidate into one handoff doc for FinOps.

Thanks —
Avery
Avery Johnson
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: commit_snapshot_q4.csv (csv, 14KB)
Attachment: BrightByte_MOU_oct2026.pdf (pdf, 220KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Avery — thanks for the callout. Quick pass on the accounts I own (short bullets):

- BrightByte (related_account: BrightByte) — Current stage: Procurement. MOU signed 10/12, procurement review ongoing. Procurement lead Lina Park expects PO by 11/18 but indicated possible negotiation on payment terms. Marked churn risk 45% (reason: extended procurement + payment-term ask). Doc: BrightByte_MOU_oct2026.pdf attached.
- CloudPeak — Stage: Contract. Legal redlines complete; awaiting counter-signature from customer legal. Forecast weight: 85%.
- NovaWorks — Stage: Proposal. Client paused for Q1 roadmap change. Marked churn risk 60% (reason: roadmap shift).

Action items for me: reach out to Lina at BrightByte today to accelerate PO; loop Naomi for any credit/term cushions.

On the commit_snapshot_q4.csv I added a column "risk_note" with the one-line reasons per your playbook.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

2) CloudPeak: Marissa -> please follow up on counter-signature today and update stage to Signed when complete.
3) NovaWorks: Dylan -> CS to own the feature-gap conversation this week; mark churn risk 60% and remove from committed backlog for Q4 planning if no movement by 11/12.

I'll compile a final cleaned commit file and hand it to FinOps by COB Friday. Please add any last-minute changes directly to commit_snapshot_q4.csv and reply if there are questions.
